svg.title: CRISPR PaperGraph: the argument, evidence and limits
svg.desc: Twelve numbered stations give the reading order of the article. Dotted connectors indicate reading order only. The linked model and interactive version retain typed scientific relations, source identities, assumptions and revision conditions. The diagram does not identify molecular accuracy or biological function.

text.tspan: Follow what is observed. Keep every inference conditional.
Question → contract → evidence → conditional conclusion → frontier.
Read stations 01–12. Dotted arrows mean “read next”, not “proves”.

g.aria-label: 1. What does an editing percentage actually establish?

text.tspan: Bind every percentage to an observation

g.aria-label: 2. Fix the unit, event and denominator

text.tspan: Local DNA, exact coding and software

g.aria-label: 3. A three-base displacement can hide a required anchor
4. Unknown records define a finite compatible set

text.tspan: Finite bounds require stated label and

g.aria-label: 5. An agreeing label need not identify an agreeing string
6. Accept a common coding string before classifying it
7. State the positive result at its actual strength
8. Stable contrast signs can coexist with changing record labels
9. Ask what a representation preserves for a declared target

text.tspan: Check fibers and joint logic on resolved

g.aria-label: 10. Keep the ambiguous and uninformative cases
11. Reproduce computations and identify their shared sources
12. Carry the result forward without crossing its boundary

text.tspan: A FORMAL DEPENDENCY, NOT A CAUSAL ARROW
Conditional theorem: not sampling coverage or molecular truth.
